idleSub: Walk into each tile to learn what it is. It takes about 20 seconds.
pausedSub: Click or press Enter to keep going.
editingSub: The game is paused while you edit.
emptySub: Add some content to this game to make it playable.
copyNote: Copied. Paste it where you need it.
copyFail: The text is selected. Copy it with Ctrl or Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Concept map game. Walk the character into each concept.
stageHow: Walk with the arrow keys or W A S D. Press N to walk to the next concept. Press Escape to pause. Press Tab to move on. The full text is also under Read it without playing.
hintKeys: Arrows or WASD to walk. N for the next concept.
hintTouch: Tap the map or use the pad
guideText: Walk into a glowing tile to find out what it is. Every tile you touch joins the map.
